author: Xyla Foxlin
description:
Another year, another Oshkosh!

25 hours of flying through hiiiigh density altitude, crossing the continental divide with 85hp at max gross, and then just… 8 hours of Nebraska.

And somehow after all of that, I ended up at Brodhead instead. But honestly, I think that was the best part.
